articles.title: Physical AI is the next frontier, and we are taking up the challenge: Raghu Dharmaraju, CEO, ARTPARK
articles.summary: ARTPARK (AI & Robotics Technology Park) at IISc, Bengaluru, led by CEO Raghu Dharmaraju, is a significant initiative. Seed-funded by the Government of India under a National Mission, it aims to advance artificial intelligence and robotics. This project underscores India's focus on fostering cutting-edge technological development, enhancing national capabilities, and driving innovation in critical future-tech domains within the country.

articles.title: Contingents to march in combat-ready battle array for first time at Republic Day Parade
articles.summary: For the first time, Indian Army contingents at the Republic Day Parade will march in a combat-ready battle array, showcasing their actual wartime deployment formations. This unprecedented move aims to project a more realistic and formidable image of the Army's operational readiness and tactical prowess, providing a deeper insight into modern military strategies for the public and international observers.

articles.title: 7 Powerful DC Heroes Who Stand No Chance Against Thanos
articles.summary: The article hypothetically explores a confrontation between Marvel's supervillain Thanos and DC Comics' powerful heroes, Superman and Wonder Woman. It analyzes how Thanos, despite his immense power in the Marvel Universe, would fare against the formidable strength and abilities of DC's iconic figures, suggesting a different outcome than his typical Marvel victories. This speculative piece compares the combat prowess of these comic book titans.

articles.title: Show HN: CIE – Open-source code intelligence engine for AI coding assistants
articles.summary: CIE is a technology aimed at enhancing code understanding for developers. It indexes codebases to enable semantic search, allowing users to find code by meaning, and performs call graph analysis. Crucially, CIE employs AI-powered code understanding through its Model Context Protocol (MCP), streamlining complex software tasks and significantly boosting development efficiency for large projects.

articles.title: U.S. Approves Potential $2.3 Billion P-8A Poseidon Sale to Singapore
articles.summary: The U.S. State Department has approved a significant Foreign Military Sale to Singapore. This includes up to four advanced Boeing P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft, crucial for surveillance and reconnaissance. The deal also comprises MK 54 lightweight torpedoes, enhancing Singapore's anti-submarine warfare capabilities. This approval strengthens bilateral security ties and modernizes Singapore's defence forces.

articles.title: Arsenal enquire about number nine attracting Barcelona and Real Madrid interest
articles.summary: Levante forward Karl Etta Eyong has rapidly ascended from Spain's third-tier football league to capture the attention of several of Europe's most prominent clubs within a few months. His consistently impressive early season form has put him on their radar, indicating a potential significant career move and fierce competition among top teams for his rising talent.
